description: Small local dev set for the text2sql-verified skill. Each task has a gold query; score predictions with: python3 scripts/text2sql.py dev --dev references/dev_set.json --preds preds.json

tasks.question: List the names of all students who scored above 90 in any course taught by professor 'Wang' in 2025.
tasks.gold_sql: SELECT DISTINCT s.name FROM Students s JOIN Enrollments e ON s.sid = e.sid JOIN Courses c ON e.cid = c.cid WHERE c.professor = 'Wang' AND c.year = 2025 AND e.score > 90

tasks.question: How many students are there in each department? Return the department and the count.
tasks.gold_sql: SELECT dept, COUNT(*) FROM Students GROUP BY dept

tasks.question: Which courses have an average score of at least 90? Return the course title.
tasks.gold_sql: SELECT c.title FROM Courses c JOIN Enrollments e ON c.cid = e.cid GROUP BY c.cid HAVING AVG(e.score) >= 90

tasks.question: List the names of students who are not enrolled in any course taught by 'Lin'.
tasks.gold_sql: SELECT name FROM Students WHERE sid NOT IN (SELECT e.sid FROM Enrollments e JOIN Courses c ON e.cid = c.cid WHERE c.professor = 'Lin')

tasks.question: Give the name of the student with the highest single score, and that score.
tasks.gold_sql: SELECT s.name, e.score FROM Students s JOIN Enrollments e ON s.sid = e.sid ORDER BY e.score DESC LIMIT 1

tasks.question: List every student name together with the number of clubs they belong to, including students in no club.
tasks.gold_sql: SELECT s.name, COUNT(m.club_id) FROM Students s LEFT JOIN Memberships m ON s.sid = m.sid GROUP BY s.sid

tasks.question: Which students scored above their own average score in at least one course? Return distinct names.
tasks.gold_sql: SELECT DISTINCT s.name FROM Students s JOIN Enrollments e ON s.sid = e.sid WHERE e.score > (SELECT AVG(e2.score) FROM Enrollments e2 WHERE e2.sid = e.sid)

tasks.question: List all professor names and all club names in a single column, without duplicates.
tasks.gold_sql: SELECT professor FROM Courses UNION SELECT club_name FROM Clubs

tasks.question: What is the total number of credits each CS student is enrolled in? Return name and total credits.
tasks.gold_sql: SELECT s.name, SUM(c.credits) FROM Students s JOIN Enrollments e ON s.sid = e.sid JOIN Courses c ON e.cid = c.cid WHERE s.dept = 'CS' GROUP BY s.sid

tasks.question: Name the club leads who enrolled before 2024.
tasks.gold_sql: SELECT s.name FROM Students s JOIN Memberships m ON s.sid = m.sid WHERE m.role = 'lead' AND s.year_enrolled < 2024
